title: 10 Euro Seven-Flower Silver Coin Set including book
descriptionPlain: When words are not enough, let flowers speak for you.An attractive bouquet of seven fantastic 10 euro coins from The Language of Flowers series is hidden inside original collector case of this series.The set makes for a special gift for a special person, whether they are friends or more, or simply someone who should know how important they are for you. The coins feature imprints of roses, dandelions, marigolds; forget-me-nots, chamomiles, peonies and violets that were all produced from living flowers, so bear a perfect resemblance to the flowers they celebrate and keep them alive for ever.This collector case contains all seven beautiful flowers coins in silver in minting quality proof including the official book of the series "Languages of Flowers" in German language:The Rose – Love and desireThe Dandelion – A wish come trueThe mMarigold – Positivity and patienceThe Forget-me-not – Remember meThe Chamomile - Strength in difficult situationsThe Peony - Good fortune and happinessThe Violet - Loyalty and devotion
